bank_name: AETS Part One 听力理解题库
schema_note: 每套题(set)含若干听力材料组(group)；每组一段对话(dialogue, P=飞行员 C=管制员)和1-4道题(questions)；answer 为正确选项字母；audio_* 为配套音频的规划路径（生成后按此命名）。
exam_note: 问题念完后5秒作答，听力只播放一遍（think_time_sec=5）。

paper_rules.说明: 组卷规则：不是150题混抽15题，而是分层随机。
paper_rules.q1_5: 从全部套卷的 slot=q1_5 组中（每套5组，共50组短对话，每组1题）完全随机抽5组，依次作为新卷 Q1-Q5。
paper_rules.q6_8: 从 slot=q6_8 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+3题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q6-Q8，不可拆分；可与其他组来自不同套卷。
paper_rules.q9_12: 从 slot=q9_12 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+4题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q9-Q12，不可拆分。
paper_rules.q13_15: 从 slot=q13_15 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+3题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q13-Q15，不可拆分。

sets.title: AETS test simulation 5
sets.directions: In this part, you are going to hear a dialogue or exchange, after the exchange, there will be a question. After each question, you have 5 seconds to think and choose the correct answer. You will hear each question only once.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Delivery, CES2341, request a mechanic, we have a hydraulic warning light on, we need a check before pushback.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES2341, Delivery, roger, maintenance is on the way.

questions.question: What service does CES2341 need?
questions.explanation: 飞行员明确说 'request a mechanic, we have a hydraulic warning light on'，即液压警告灯亮，需要机务（机械维修）检查，故选 D。加油、医疗、配餐均未提及。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN6608, Wuhan Ground, you are on the wrong taxiway, continue taxi via P, R2, N to holding point of RWY05L.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Continue taxi via P, R2 and N to holding point, RWY05L, CSN6608.

questions.question: How should CSN6608 taxi?

options.A: P2, R, N to holding point, RWY05L
options.B: P, R2, N to holding point, RWY05L
options.C: N, R2, P to holding point, RWY05L
options.D: P, R2, N to holding point, RWY05R

questions.explanation: 管制员指令 'continue taxi via P, R2, N to holding point of RWY05L'，滑行路线为 P、R2、N 至 05L 跑道等待点，与 B 完全一致；A 把滑行道名搞错，C 顺序颠倒，D 跑道号错误。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Control, CCA4156, a passenger has lost consciousness due to a severe allergic reaction, we need medical support immediately.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA4156, Control, roger PANPAN, say your intentions.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Request divert to Wuhan, CCA4156.

questions.question: Why is CCA4156 making an urgency call?

options.A: Because a passenger had a heart attack.
options.C: Because a passenger had a stroke.
options.D: Because a passenger fainted due to an allergic reaction.

questions.explanation: 飞行员宣布 PANPAN 并说明 'a passenger has lost consciousness due to a severe allergic reaction'，即乘客因严重过敏反应失去知觉（昏厥），故选 D。心脏病、中风、失压均与原文不符。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: JAL3051, Wuhan Approach, follow DA-01A Arrival, expect ILS approach RWY36L, descend to 2100m on QNH1015, Info R.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Roger, DA-02A Arrival, ILS approach RWY36L, JAL3051.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: JAL3051, negative, DA-01A Arrival, descend to 2100m on QNH1015, Info R.

questions.question: What mistake did the pilot make during the readback?

options.A: The pilot was wrong about the callsign and missed altitude.
options.B: The pilot was wrong about the runway and missed Info.
options.C: The pilot was wrong about the Arrival procedure and missed altitude and Info.
options.D: The pilot was wrong about the altitude and missed the Arrival procedure.

questions.explanation: 管制员指令是 'DA-01A Arrival'，飞行员复诵成 'DA-02A Arrival'，进场程序报错；同时复诵漏掉了高度 '2100m on QNH1015' 和通播 'Info R'，管制员随后纠正，故选 C。呼号和跑道复诵均正确。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach, AFR6632, we have traffic indication at 9 o'clock, 10nm, 200m below us, it appears stationary, confirm.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: AFR6632, it's a police helicopter on patrol, maintain 3900m.

questions.question: Where is the helicopter?
questions.explanation: 飞行员报告 'traffic indication at 9 o'clock, 10nm, 200m below us, it appears stationary'，管制员确认为巡逻警用直升机；'stationary'（悬停）对应 hovering，位置 9 点钟、10 海里、低 200 米，故选 C。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CES5280, ready.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES5280, cleared for takeoff, RWY18, surface wind 260 degrees 3m/s, after airborne, contact Departure on 120.3.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Cleared for takeoff, Departure 120.3, CES5280.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CES5280, 350m climbing. We had a lightning strike and lost the transponder, request return to land.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES5280, roger, continue runway heading, turn left after 700m, do you need any assistance?

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Continue runway heading, turn left after 700m, request maintenance upon landing, CES5280.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: Roger, CES5280, maintenance will be ready for you. Contact Approach 126.45.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach, 126.45, thanks, CES5280.

questions.question: What is the wind condition when CES5280 takes off?
questions.explanation: 塔台通报 'surface wind 260 degrees 3m/s'，风速仅 3 米/秒，属于轻风（light wind），无阵风、无强侧风、也非静风，故选 B。

questions.question: What happened to CES5280 during takeoff?
questions.explanation: 飞行员爬升时报告 'We had a lightning strike and lost the transponder'，即遭雷击并导致应答机失效，故选 A。襟翼故障、鸟击、发动机喘振均未提及。

questions.question: Which frequency should CES5280 call finally?
questions.explanation: 对话最后管制员指令 'Contact Approach 126.45'，飞行员复诵 'Approach, 126.45'，故最终应联系 126.45，选 A。120.3 是起飞后最初联系的离场频率，不是最后的。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3902, Wuhan Control, due traffic, offset 2nm right of track, expect rejoin the route at ZF.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Roger, offset 2nm right of track, CSN3902.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Control, CSN3902, we have weather indication 15nm ahead of us, request deviate to the right for 8nm.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3902, negative due to prohibited area, can you accept deviation to the left?

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Affirm, we need a heading of 110 for 12nm, CSN3902.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3902, turn left heading 110, report clear of weather.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Left heading 110, wilco, CSN3902.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan Control, CSN3902, our left engine caught fire, the fire is now extinguished. We are emergency descending to 5400m on one engine.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3902, Wuhan Control, roger MAYDAY, report reaching. Break Break. All stations, Wuhan Control, emergency descent between XS and ZF, all aircraft below 8900m, leave the route to the west.

questions.question: How can CSN3902 avoid the weather according to the pilot?

options.A: Deviate to the right side for 8nm.
options.B: Deviate to the right side for 15nm.
options.C: Deviate to the left side for 12nm.

questions.explanation: 飞行员报告前方 15 海里有天气并 'request deviate to the right for 8nm'，即请求向右偏 8 海里绕飞，故选 A。15nm 是天气距离，12nm 是后来改向左绕飞的距离。

questions.question: Why can't CSN3902 detour the weather from the right side?

options.A: Because there is a prohibited area.
options.C: Because there is a restricted area.
options.D: Because there is a lightning strike.

questions.explanation: 管制员回复 'negative due to prohibited area'，即因右侧有禁区（prohibited area）拒绝右绕，故选 A。限制区（restricted area）与禁区含义不同，军事活动和雷击均未提及。

questions.question: What happened to CSN3902?

options.A: CSN3902 encountered lightning strike and fuel leakage.
options.C: CSN3902 had an engine fire and the fire is extinguished.

questions.explanation: 飞行员宣布 MAYDAY：'our left engine caught fire, the fire is now extinguished'，即左发失火但火已扑灭，故选 C。雷击漏油、快速释压、风挡裂纹均与原文不符。

questions.question: Where is CSN3902 when he started emergency descent?

options.D: West of XS and ZF at 5400m.

questions.explanation: 管制员向全体通报 'emergency descent between XS and ZF'，飞行员报告正 'emergency descending to 5400m'，即飞机在 XS 与 ZF 之间紧急下降至 5400 米，故选 B。8900 米是要求其他航空器脱离航路的高度下限，不是该机位置高度。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Wuhan Tower, CHH7102, 11nm final, established ILS, RWY36.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CHH7102, Wuhan Tower, continue approach, reduce speed to 155kts, report outer marker.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Continue approach, speed 155kts, report outer marker, CHH7102.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CHH7102, Tower, cleared to land, RWY36, wind 360, 5m/s, gusting up to 11m/s. QNH1018.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Cleared to land, RWY36, QNH1018, thanks, CHH7102.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CHH7102, we had a brake fire indication after landing and stopped on the runway, the brakes are overheated. Unable to vacate runway, request fire service and a tug.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CHH7102, roger, fire service and tug are on the way. Break Break. CSN8806, go around, I say again, go around, runway occupied due to aircraft unable to vacate.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Going around, CSN8806.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CSN8806, a passenger fell down and got injured during the missed approach, request an ambulance upon arrival.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN8806, roger, contact Wuhan Approach on 128.3.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach, 128.3, CSN8806.

questions.question: Why did CHH7102 stop on the runway?

options.A: The nose gear was stuck in the mud.
options.C: The brakes overheated with a fire indication.
options.D: A tire burst on the main gear.

questions.explanation: 飞行员报告 'we had a brake fire indication after landing and stopped on the runway, the brakes are overheated'，即刹车过热并出现火警指示，故停在跑道上，选 C。并非发动机起火或轮胎、起落架问题。

questions.question: What was the consequence of CHH7102's problem?

options.A: The passengers were evacuated by slides.
options.B: The aircraft skidded off the runway.
options.D: The aircraft was unable to vacate the runway and needed a tug.

questions.explanation: 飞行员明确说 'Unable to vacate runway, request fire service and a tug'，即无法脱离跑道并需要拖车，后果是跑道被占用（后续 CSN8806 因此复飞），故选 D。未提及撤离滑梯、滑出跑道或乘客受伤（受伤的是 CSN8806 上的乘客）。

questions.question: What was CSN8806's request after the missed approach?
questions.explanation: 复飞后 CSN8806 报告 'a passenger fell down and got injured during the missed approach, request an ambulance upon arrival'，即请求落地后派救护车，故选 B。消防和拖车是 CHH7102 的请求，128.3 是管制员要求其联系的频率而非请求内容。
